subject: POC kickoff: success metrics & next-steps (Aurora Tech)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@auroratech.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@auroratech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff: success metrics & next-steps (Aurora Tech)

Hi Aditi / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our call, I wanted to capture a concise POC (trial) plan so we have alignment on scope, timeline, and owners. I pulled together an initial set of success criteria and a proposed 4-week evaluation plan — please see the bullets below and the attached "poc-success-metrics-template.xlsx" for a simple tracking sheet.

High-level objective
- Validate Redwood Inference can meet Aurora Tech's latency and throughput targets for real-time chat summarization in prod-like traffic (90th percentile latency <= 450ms at 50 RPS).

Proposed success criteria (measurable)
- Latency: 90th percentile per-request latency <= 450ms for 1024-token context with our quantized model variant.
- Throughput: Sustain 50 concurrent requests per second with <5% error rate.
- Cost per 1K tokens: within 20% of the baseline estimate we showed in the pricing sheet.
- Quality: Rouge-L >= 0.72 on your 200-case test set OR manual acceptance on 90% of sampled outputs.
- Integration: End-to-end demo (Aurora UI -> Redwood API -> stored artifacts) with logs and KV cache behaviors validated.

Suggested timeline & ownership
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, environment access, security questionnaire handoff (owner: Aurora / Ben).
- Week 1: Baseline measurements on your representative traffic + small tuning run (owner: Redwood / Karthik + Jasmine).
- Week 2: Iterative tuning, caching policy validation, and cost profiling (owner: Redwood).
- Week 3: Quality validation vs. Aurora test set and manual review (owner: Aurora + Redwood).
- Week 4: Wrap-up, measurement review, and decision review (owner: both).

Open items / asks from Aurora
- Access: Service account key + sample traffic traces (anonymized) by EOD Thu.
- Success acceptance: confirm whether automated metric thresholds OR manual QA will be the final gate.
- Security: your completed questionnaire (we attached a one-pager to this thread).

Attachments: poc-success-metrics-template.xlsx (tracking sheet), redwood-sow-draft.pdf (draft SOW for reserved capacity option).

Proposed next steps
1) Confirm acceptance criteria above or provide edits by Thu 12/3.
2) Kickoff call to hand off keys + SSO details — do you have 30 minutes on Friday 12/4 10:00–10:30 PT?
3) We’ll publish a shared runbook link for test harness and post results.

I’ll follow up internally with Karthik and Marissa to align resources. Happy to tighten any of the metrics — wanted to start with concrete numbers so we can move quickly.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0142

Subject: Re: POC kickoff: success metrics & next-steps (Aurora Tech)

Thanks Jasmine — this is great and very actionable. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The latency target looks sensible; can we confirm whether the 1024-token context is per incoming user or includes system prompts? We’ll standardize and send sample traces.
- For Quality: we prefer a mix of automated metric + manual QA. We'll accept if Rouge-L >= 0.70 AND at least 85% of a 50-sample manual spot-check pass.
- Security: I’m attaching our security questions spreadsheet. We’ll also need a brief note on your data retention and log redaction policy.

Ben and I can provide anonymized traces by EOD Thu (we need to scrub customer identifiers). Kickoff on Fri 12/4 10:00 PT works for us. Please send the calendar invite.

One ask: can you provision a short-lived VPC endpoint for the trial? We want to test routing overhead with a private link. If not possible for the initial week, we can do the baseline on the hosted endpoint and move to a private link in Week 2.

Thanks — Aditi
Aditi Rao
Head of AI Platform, Aurora Tech
aditi.rao@auroratech.com

Perfect — invite sent for Fri 12/4 10:00–10:30 PT (Google Meet link in calendar).

Quick answers and final notes before the call: 
- Context tokens: we'll standardize on "user + system" = 1024 tokens for benchmarking; please include any persistent prompt text in your trace files.
- VPC endpoint: We can provision a short-lived VPC endpoint for Week 2. For the baseline load test in Week 1 we’ll use the hosted endpoint to move faster. If Aurora confirms Week 2 private link, Karthik will coordinate networking.
- Security & retention: attached a one-page note (inline in the SOW PDF) that summarizes data retention (30 days by default, configurable) and redaction options. If you need an HSM/KMS diagram, we can add it to the next revision.

Attached: redwood-sow-draft.pdf (with inline security summary). I updated the SOW headline to include a 4-week trial period and a clear escalation path. Karthik will push the reserved-capacity language update later today.

Next steps (final):
1) Aurora to upload anonymized traces + confirm acceptance method by Thu 12/3 (Aditi).
2) Redwood to run baseline Week 1 on hosted endpoint; VPC endpoint targeted for Week 2.
3) Weekly sync every Friday while POC is active; first health check scheduled for Fri 12/11.
4) Post-trial decision review meeting to be booked in Week 4.

Look forward to the kickoff — see you on the call.

Best,
Jasmine
